title: Tymers
description: Pack focused on exploration and building, with create integrations.
body:
This modpack was crafted to provide a fun and immersive experience for me and my friends, moving beyond the vanilla gameplay of Minecraft. It combines exploration, creativity, and a touch of chaos to create a well-rounded adventure.

At its core, the Create mod takes center stage, offering endless opportunities for innovation and automation. Build intricate contraptions, automate resource gathering, and bring your wildest mechanical ideas to life! To complement this, Biomes O' Plenty introduces a stunning variety of biomes, making exploration more exciting with breathtaking landscapes and unique resources.

For those who enjoy a cozy and agricultural experience, Farmer's Delight enhances farming with new crops, recipes, and tools, giving players more ways to grow, cook, and thrive. Early-game mobility gets a boost with Gliders, providing elytra-like mechanics to soar across the world before obtaining endgame gear. And if you’re a fan of adorable creatures, a selection of mods adds cute mobs to make the world feel more alive and charming.

Whether you're adventuring through new biomes, crafting delightful meals, tinkering with ingenious machines, or simply enjoying the company of cute creatures, this modpack ensures there's something for everyone. Gather your friends and dive into a Minecraft experience like no other—filled with discovery, innovation, and, of course, plenty of shenanigans!
